stock.description: Adtiger Corporations Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily offering digital advertising solutions across Mainland China, Singapore, Hong Kong, and various international territories. The firm maintains an online platform designed to forge connections between advertisers and diverse media publishers. A significant aspect of its business entails furnishing international online advertising opportunities specifically tailored for clients based in China. Adtiger Corporations Limited was established in 2015 and is centrally located in Beijing, China.
